verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is a self-hosted, open-source gateway that runs on the user's own machine. Its documented storage design keeps data in open, portable formats: agent memory is plain Markdown files in `~/.openclaw/workspace`, skills are `SKILL.md` directories with YAML frontmatter, and session history is SQLite-backed per agent. Leaving amounts to taking those local files, but no dedicated export or migration feature is documented. Missing for 10: a documented export/backup command or data-portability guide, confirmation that all state (config, credentials, channel sessions, automations) is in open formats, and hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.
